children: Soybean futures on the CBOT rise 0.5% after starting the day in negative territory. One factor giving them support is the USDA's latest flash sales announcement on soybeans to China. The USDA says 192,000 metric tons were sold for delivery in the 2026/27 marketing year. It's the third straight day the USDA announced soybean flash sales to China, with 530,000 tons of soybeans sold over that time. This, combined with strong weekly sales reported by the USDA, is buoying soybean futures. "Soybeans saw a rush of mid-morning dip buyers due to demand support after facing profit-taking overnight and early in the daytime session," says Brian Grete of Commstock Investments. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
